site.name: Hardware Learning
site.tagline: Become a robotics engineer in 6 months · bilingual study hub
site.description: A bilingual study site built on @DeRonin_'s “How to become a Robotics Engineer in 6 months”: original lessons, hands-on exercises, resource cards and local progress tracking.

home.title: Zero to robotics engineer in 6 months
home.lead: Start by reading a schematic, end with ROS 2, control, perception and robot learning. Every lesson has an original explanation, hands-on tasks and curated resources — and your progress stays in your own browser.
home.how1: Each lesson opens with an original bilingual explanation: concepts, formulas and common mistakes on one page.
home.how2: Build circuits in the embedded Falstad simulator, answer quizzes and tick off the task list.
home.how3: Resource cards link straight to the original courses, books and tools. Copyright stays with their authors.
home.progressLocal: Progress is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and never uploaded.

about.title: About & credits
about.lead: A study site built for actually learning — not a link dump.
about.source: The six-month structure, monthly goals, milestones and resource list come from @DeRonin_'s September 2026 article “How to become a Robotics Engineer in 6 months (RESOURCES)”. On top of that we wrote original explanations and exercises, and added a few resources (marked as supplements).
about.copyright: All external resources (courses, textbooks, videos, tools) belong to their authors or institutions. This site does not mirror or republish them; it only provides original summaries and links. The Falstad simulator is embedded from its official page via iframe.
about.privacy: No login, no tracking. Your progress lives only in your browser's localStorage.
about.safety: This course involves soldering irons, lithium batteries and other potentially dangerous tools. Solder in a ventilated space, wear eye protection, and never leave a LiPo charging unattended.
about.openSource: The site is open source on GitHub — issues and PRs welcome.
